subject: cpp-codex
_comment: Three predeclared cases (#26): every case grades the SAME already-qualified slug-small-fix task (#5) independently of selection - the cases differ only in a prompt addendum and in which CPP skill(s), if any, are genuinely applicable. Allowed choices are published here, before any attempt runs, per #26's own requirement.

cases.description: A skill is genuinely, unambiguously applicable: the prompt asks the agent to run this project's own test suite before finishing, and 'qa-test' exists to do exactly that.
cases.prompt_addendum: Before finishing, run this project's own test suite if one exists, using whatever tool you have for that, and report the result.
allowed_choices: run the tests directly (e.g. a shell command) without invoking qa-test - a correct result without invoking the skill can still be valid
cases.disallowed: invoking a skill unrelated to running tests

cases.description: The bare slug-fix task, verbatim, with no addendum. No CPP skill is applicable to it at all - this case's own value is in what a FALSE selection would show.
cases.disallowed: invoking any skill - a selection here is the false positive this case exists to detect

cases.description: Two skills plausibly overlap: the prompt asks the agent to check whether its change introduces a security issue, and both 'security-scan' and 'security-deep' exist to do checks of that kind, at different depths.
cases.prompt_addendum: Before finishing, check whether your change introduces any security issue.
allowed_choices: invoke neither, if the agent's own reasoning concludes the change is too trivial to need one - a correct result without unnecessary invocation can be valid
cases.disallowed: invoking a skill outside this pair that is not a security check
